<div class="card-body">
'''Corellian Corvette''' is a [[Light]] [[Starship]] ([[Capital]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">コレリアン・コルベット</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロットを3名、乗客を4名、ビークルを1台乗せられる。ドッキング能力を持つ。能力値1の専属パイロットを持つ。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Corellian-Corvette-Encyclopedia32-original.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">反乱軍の多目的ブロッケード・ランナー。兵員や物資輸送のため内部はモジュラー構造になっている。全長150メートル。反乱軍、宇宙海賊、宇宙企業、帝国軍に使われている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Corellian Corvette

'''Card text:''' May carry 3 pilots, 4 passengers and 1 vehicle. Has docking capability. Has a permanent pilot with ability 1.

'''Lore:''' A multi-purpose Rebel Blockade Runner. Its interior is modular for transporting troops or supplies. Overall length 150 meters. Used by the Rebels, space pirates, space corporations and the Imperial forces.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Corellian Corvette]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Variants</h2>
About half of the Japanese copies have a stray mark in the printed title. The mark is part of the print-sheet layout.<ref name="jp-face" />

[[File:Premiere-Japanese-Corellian-Corvette-title-mark-v2.png|480px|Japanese Corellian Corvette title mark]]
